description: This file defines the 'Context' type and associated functions for TensorFlow's eager execution mode in Go. It includes configuration handling, context creation, device listing, and interoperability with the C API.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Encapsulates the eager execution context in TensorFlow, managing devices and execution configuration.

classes.name: ContextOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for creating a new TensorFlow eager execution context.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Converts ContextOptions to C API's TF_ContextOptions, setting configuration including the Config proto and async mode.

methods.name: NewContext
methods.description: Creates a new eager execution context with the specified options, setting up C API resources and finalizers.

methods.name: finalizer
methods.description: Cleans up the underlying C context when the Go Context object is garbage collected.

methods.name: ListDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of devices associated with the current Context, interfacing with the C API to retrieve device information.
